create_between_cost_function: create a Between cost function with two LieGroup variables and a measurement
compute_between_error: compute the error tensor for a Between cost function using the between operation
compute_between_jacobians: compute the Jacobian matrices for a Between cost function with respect to its variables
get_between_dimension: get the dimension of a Between cost function using its degrees of freedom
copy_between_cost_function: copy a Between cost function with all its variables and weight to a new instance
